specification.objective: Replace the README's SVG workflow diagram with the user's supplied PNG under a clear repository-relative name, preserve its original bytes, and add an enabled-suite regression for the local accessible image reference.

requirements.statement: README uses descriptive non-empty alt text and the repository-relative docs/magi-memory-workflow.png image link, and no longer references the old docs/magi-workflow.svg diagram.
The PNG in the repository is an unmodified byte-for-byte copy of /Users/marcos.lopes/Downloads/Human-Reviewed Memory Workflow.png (1672x941 RGB PNG).
The existing tests/test_desktop.py suite asserts the README image alt/link, local file existence, and PNG signature/dimensions; the obsolete SVG asset is removed.
No runtime code, version metadata, unrelated documentation, dependencies, or generated image transformations are changed; configured project gates pass.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The README contains exactly the descriptive relative PNG image link and does not refer to the old SVG.
The repository asset exists, has the PNG signature, is 1672x941, and cmp plus SHA-256 confirm exact equality with the supplied source file.
The new README image regression is present in the existing ci/test.sh suite and fails on the clean baseline for the expected missing-image assertion before implementation.
POLIS workspace validation and all enabled gates pass on the exact target tree; only declared README/test/image paths change.

invariants.statement: Preserve the user-supplied PNG bytes exactly; do not resize, recompress, recolor, or crop it.
Retain the existing cover and Pending writes / Stored memory screenshots and their test assertions.
Do not change the current version, product/runtime behavior, release history, or dependency graph.
README image paths remain relative and the alt text remains meaningful for screen readers.

forbidden_states.statement: README points to the Downloads path, a remote asset, a missing file, or the obsolete SVG.
The copied image bytes differ from the supplied source or the new regression test is skipped by ci/test.sh.
Unrelated source, release metadata, screenshots, tests, or documentation are modified.

inputs.statement: User requests replacing the README workflow graphic with /Users/marcos.lopes/Downloads/Human-Reviewed Memory Workflow.png, renaming it for the repository, and pushing.
Clean main baseline at 77556cc67c094beef336740b1d0b3a99e465f35e; current README references docs/magi-workflow.svg.
Source image is 1672x941 RGB PNG with SHA-256 848d874021a7f0d8d8c9ae3befce01863e180b66ecefa09a5019c7e17d4578d5.

outputs.statement: README displays the supplied workflow infographic from docs/magi-memory-workflow.png with descriptive alt text.
A regression assertion in tests/test_desktop.py and exact source/asset byte verification protect the image reference and asset.
Validated commits pushed non-force to main, with final CI and clean remote state verified.

failure_semantics.statement: If the regression fails for a dependency/setup reason rather than the expected baseline assertion, stop and repair proof prerequisites; do not claim Red.
If byte comparison, configured gates, or remote CI fails, do not claim successful delivery; preserve the exact failure and correct or report it.
